records.source: With all this space, I can really achieve a full body workout.
records.translation: 有這麼大的空間，我真的能充分鍛鍊全身。

records.source: I never had many friends in town... I sometimes wonder how I'd end up if you never moved here.$9
records.translation: 我在鎮上一直沒多少朋友……有時會想，如果你不曾搬來，自己最後會變成什麼樣子。$9

records.source: Aw... I was gonna do some jogging outside. But I can't really do it in this weather.
records.translation: 唉……我本來打算到外面慢跑，但這種天氣實在沒辦法。

records.source: *grumble*... I just woke up and I'm hungry for some protein.$9
records.translation: *嘟囔*……我才剛醒，就想吃點蛋白質。$9

records.source: I think I might start reading books. I don't want to become stagnant now that I'm a married guy!
records.translation: 我想自己或許該開始讀書。既然已經結婚，我可不想停滯不前！

records.source: Unghh... one... Unghhh... two... It feels great to lift weights outdoors!$6
records.translation: 呃啊……一……呃啊……二……在戶外舉重真舒服！$6

records.source: Hey, did you have a good day? I'm sure tomorrow will be even better.$h
records.translation: 嘿，你今天過得愉快嗎？我相信明天會更好。$h

records.source: How's it going? I've been carrying the old gridball around with me all day. A guy can pretend...$u
records.translation: 過得如何？我整天都帶著那顆舊格球。至少能假裝一下……$u

records.source: Oh... the smell? I've been eating garlic all day. I'm trying to stay manly... Sorry.$l
records.translation: 喔……你說這股味道？我整天都在吃大蒜，想保持男子氣概……抱歉。$l

records.source: I've been setting aside a few scraps for Dusty. He deserves a treat now and then.
records.translation: 我一直替達斯提留些剩菜。牠偶爾也值得吃頓好料。

records.source: I was hungry so I made some dinner. Here, I saved you a plate. [241 242 225 214 198]$h
records.translation: 我肚子餓了，所以做了些晚餐。來，我替你留了一盤。[241 242 225 214 198]$h

records.source: Ahh... there's nothing like a good night's sleep next to my husband!$h^Ahh... there's nothing like a good night's sleep next to my wife!$h
records.translation: 啊……沒有什麼比睡在丈夫身旁，一夜好眠更棒了！$h^啊……沒有什麼比睡在妻子身旁，一夜好眠更棒了！$h

records.source: Hey, honey! I made you a hot breakfast.[195 210 211]#$e#If you want to get strong, you have to eat like you mean it!
records.translation: 嘿，親愛的！我替你做了熱騰騰的早餐。[195 210 211]#$e#想變強壯，吃東西時就得認真！

records.source: Come here. *squeeze*... Mmhmm. You're firming up from all that farm work.
records.translation: 過來。*用力抱住*……嗯哼。做了這麼多農場工作，你的身體變結實了。

records.source: I'm still getting used to cooking and doing laundry... It's not exactly my favorite, but I knew what I was getting into when I married you.$h
records.translation: 我還在適應下廚和洗衣服……雖然不算最喜歡的事，但跟你結婚時，我就知道自己會面對什麼。$h

records.source: There's a couple things around the house that I'm going to try and fix today. Don't worry about me, I'm not bored.
records.translation: 今天我打算試著修理屋裡的幾樣東西。別擔心，我不會覺得無聊。

records.source: It feels good to push yourself to the limit, doesn't it? You'll really feel like you earned your place in the soft bed tonight.
records.translation: 逼自己達到極限的感覺很好，對吧？今晚躺進柔軟床鋪時，你一定會覺得這份舒適是努力賺來的。

records.source: Did you get a haircut or something? You're looking pretty good today. Maybe it's all that fresh air...$l
records.translation: 你剪頭髮了嗎？今天看起來很不錯。也許是因為吸了那麼多新鮮空氣……$l

records.source: Tell me all about your day. It's good to get everything off your chest now and then.
records.translation: 把今天發生的一切都告訴我。偶爾把心裡的話全說出來是件好事。

records.source: Hey... I got some new shorts. I thought you might be interested to know...$l
records.translation: 嘿……我買了條新短褲。想說你或許會有興趣知道……$l

records.source: If you need some quiet time to yourself, that's okay with me.
records.translation: 如果你需要獨自安靜一會兒，我不介意。

records.source: Hey. When I stand here and look out over our land... I'm really proud. You've done great work.
records.translation: 嘿。站在這裡眺望我們的土地……我真的很驕傲。你做得非常好。

records.source: This is a great place to raise children. I would've loved growing up in a place like this. So much room to run around!
records.translation: 這裡很適合養育孩子。如果小時候能在這種地方長大，我一定很開心。有這麼大的空間可以到處跑！

records.source: I like to spend as much time outside as possible. It just feels better to be out here.
records.translation: 我喜歡盡可能多待在戶外。身處外面就是感覺更舒服。

records.source: Look at us, with our little farm. We make a cute couple.$h^Hey. Maybe it's the golden light, but you look beautiful today.$l
records.translation: 看看我們，還有這座小農場。我們真是可愛的一對。$h^嘿，也許是金色陽光的緣故，但你今天看起來好美。$l
